entries.zh: 鲠（骨鲠在喉）；卡在喉咙里
entries.en: to be stuck across the throat (a bone caught in the gullet)

entries.zh: 鲠着吞不下去（骨鲠在喉、咽不下）
entries.en: stuck, unable to swallow (a bone caught in the throat)

entries.zh: 横（横过、横阻在路上）
entries.en: to lie across, cross, block the way

entries.zh: 横路（横在路上；横过的路）
entries.en: across the road; a cross-road

entries.zh: 把物横放（将东西横过来搁置）
entries.en: to lay a thing crosswise, place it athwart

entries.zh: 包货（包揽全部货物；包买全部产业）
entries.en: to buy up the whole cargo/stock (bulk purchase, corner the goods)

entries.zh: 栋（屋栋，横架之栋木，如比雅木 Bija 之横材）
entries.en: the ridge-beam of a roof (cross-beam, as of the Bija wood)
entries.notes: 西语 ut la Bija 为举例缩略，具体所指木料依推断。

entries.zh: 栋樑材（栋梁之木材，可作横樑的木料）
entries.en: timber for beams, ridge-pole wood; material for the rafters/beam

entries.zh: 驳（横断、截断；斥驳，指被驳斥之词）
entries.en: to cross-cut, contradict, rebut; the rebuttal
entries.notes: 西语原文讹误较多（tequesto/apaparado），释义依汉字与闽音推断。

entries.zh: 重货（沉甸甸压在船上的货物；横陈之重物）
entries.en: heavy cargo (goods lying heavy athwart the hold)

entries.zh: 覆竹〔原件疑作腹竹〕（横架之覆竹／肚兜式竹排；界限、界标）
entries.en: a laid-across bamboo cover; a boundary-mark (marco)
entries.notes: [疑]栏存异读，西语 marco（界标）与汉字对应关系存疑。

entries.zh: 敢、敢作（自恃敢于横行）
entries.en: to dare, venture (presume, take upon oneself)

entries.zh: 侵（侵犯、侵凌，敢来冒犯）
entries.en: to invade, encroach, presume upon (dare to offend)

entries.zh: 漭〔原件疑作潯〕（胆大莽撞、放胆）
entries.en: bold, daring (audacious)
entries.notes: [疑]栏存异读；西语 atreuido tamì 语义与汉字吻合故作大胆义。

entries.zh: 敢作敢当（敢冒险、敢于担当）
entries.en: to dare to act and dare to bear the consequences; to brave danger

entries.zh: 斗胆（大胆冒犯，尤指在恶事上胆大）
entries.en: audacious, presumptuous (bold even in evil)

entries.zh: 胆（胆量；大胆的）
entries.en: bold, daring; the gall (boldness)

entries.zh: 莽荡〔原件疑作冏湯〕（鲁莽放荡、胡作妄为的胆大）
entries.en: rash and reckless, wantonly daring (bestially bold)
entries.notes: [疑]栏存异读，取莽荡以合 bestial 义。

entries.zh: 粗心（心粗胆大、凶狠粗鲁）
entries.en: coarse-hearted, fierce and rough (crude and bold)

entries.zh: 不谅（不信不谅，硬执不使人信；固执己见而不体谅）
entries.en: untrustworthy, refusing credence; obstinately sure of oneself
entries.notes: 西语原文 fabent 讹误难解，以不谅之经典语义（不使人信）推断。

entries.zh: 勇敢（勇敢、勇猛）
entries.en: brave, valiant, courageous

entries.zh: 扯过〔原件作冊探，存疑〕（伸手扯过来、拉过）
entries.en: to pull over, drag across (pull a thing to oneself)
entries.notes: 汉字栏残疑（冊探/扯过），西语 A til delibin 讹误，释义依闽官对音推断。
